name: Skills
summary: Inline Skills (agentskills.io SKILL.md) referenced by a toolbox attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: Foundry Skills let you package reusable instructions (SKILL.md) and roll them out to agents via a Toolbox. Because Toolboxes themselves are rejected by BYOM (see the toolboxes card), skills cannot be delivered to a BYOM agent — the skill resource itself provisions, but the delivery vehicle is blocked.
notes: Downstream of the toolbox_search_preview BYOM block. Also worth noting: the SDK create call for skills triggers a transient `state 'Creating'` conflict on the automatic LRO poll (skills are created async), so the test wraps that as a soft warning rather than a hard failure.
